en.headline: Film Archive screens Cheng Pei-pei tribute this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Film Archive shows a Mandarin feature at 11am on Friday, with a Cantonese talk afterwards, in a series remembering Cheng Pei-pei.
body: The Hong Kong Film Archive is screening a morning film today as part of a tribute series to the actress Cheng Pei-pei.

The archive lists the Friday session at 11am in its cinema, with Mandarin dialogue and Chinese and English subtitles. A talk in Cantonese follows the screening. The series is billed as a morning programme remembering Cheng.
Tickets are 40 dollars, or 20 dollars at the concession rate, the archive said. The same series screened another Cheng film on Thursday morning.

The archive's October calendar also lists screenings from a mainland Chinese film programme on Saturday and Sunday, at 75 dollars, or 38 dollars concession. Those sessions are separate from the Friday morning tribute.

zh.headline: 電影資料館今早放映鄭佩佩紀念場
zh.dek: 香港電影資料館周五上午11時放映《蘭嶼之歌》，國語對白、中英文字幕，映後設粵語講談，屬紀念鄭佩佩的影畫早晨系列。
body: 香港電影資料館今早放映一場紀念影星鄭佩佩的電影，屬資料館「影畫早晨：俠影翩躚——懷念鄭佩佩」系列。
今場是上午11時的《蘭嶼之歌》，國語對白，配中英文字幕，放映地點為電影資料館電影院。資料館表示映後設粵語講談。
票價為40元，優惠票20元。同一系列周四早上亦放映過另一部鄭佩佩電影。
資料館10月節目表另列周六及周日的中國內地電影展場次，票價75元，優惠票38元，與今早的紀念場分開售票。
